The main takeaway from our work is that
in vitro susceptibility testing is a useful adjunct to clinical judgment when choosing an antibiotic for treatment of canine urinary tract infections.
in vitro susceptibility testing can be used to predict the outcome of antimicrobial therapy in canine UTI.
the use of antibiotics to treat UTI in dogs and cats can be improved by using in vitro susceptibility testing to predict the likelihood of response.
